main.description: A group role and its group-wide grants, keyed by role ID. Role IDs follow label value syntax ([a-z-]+) and are at least 3 characters. Written by the group in the members space. Grants within a space live in that space's policy.

default.description: If true, granted to members admitted through requestJoin.

permissions.description: Group-wide permissions, one per item. For permissions not tied to one space, such as manage=create, rpc: permissions, and space:* grants.

canAssign.description: Keys of roles this role may assign, or * for every role.
